title: Why Your Website Needs llms.txt

cover.alt: A website passes llms.txt to an AI agent that forms an answer

tldr: When an AI agent is asked about you or your product, it does not read visual hierarchy or infer which facts matter most. llms.txt and a linked profile give it a concise, verifiable entry point. They do not replace a website, SEO, or documentation; they make existing information easier for a machine to use.
